title: Date-Night Cadence Tracker
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=datenight:log
| stats latest(_time) as last_date, count as total
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_date)/86400,0), overdue=if(days_since>21,1,0)
description: Tracks how long it has been since your last proper date night and nudges you when life has crowded it out.
value: Regular quality time slips first when life gets busy; a gentle cadence nudge helps keep a relationship a priority.
implementation: Log date nights into `index=personal`; alert when it has been too long since the last one.
visualization: Single-value tile of days since last date night.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how long since your last date night and reminds you when it is time to plan another.
